title: Parameters
blurb: Named numbers with limits drive the model; change one and the part rebuilds.
alt: Three teal plates from one function: the 40 mm plate with three holes in front, and wider plates with more holes behind.

title: Extrude
blurb: A flat sketch, holes included, pushed out into a solid.
alt: A length of silver 20 x 20 T-slot framing: a T-slot in each face and a centre bore running its full length.

title: Revolve
blurb: A profile turned about an axis, here three quarters of the way round.
alt: A teal flanged bushing with a quarter cut away, the turned profile showing in amber.

title: Sweep
blurb: A section carried along a path of lines and arcs.
alt: A teal rectangular duct that runs in, up and over through two bends in different planes, its hollow section painted amber at both ends.

title: Loft
blurb: One solid stretched through several cross-sections.
alt: A teal vase that starts round at the foot, pinches at the waist and opens into a square mouth.

title: Booleans
blurb: Join two solids, cut one from the other, or keep only the overlap.
alt: A rounded block joined to a pin, the block with a slot where the pin was cut away, and their overlap in amber, faint outlines showing the inputs each result no longer has.

title: Threads
blurb: Bolts and nuts from the standard library carry real helical threads.
alt: A teal M12 hex bolt with chamfered head and tip, and an amber chamfered nut part way up its thread.

title: Chamfer
blurb: Pick edges by the face they belong to and cut them back to a flat.
alt: A teal vise jaw with vee grooves and countersunk screw holes, its bevelled top edges picked out in amber.

title: Fillet
blurb: Round the edges you select, each set with its own radius.
alt: A tan machined pedestal: the base plate's corners and the boss's top rim rounded, every other edge left sharp.

title: Mirror
blurb: Model one half and reflect it across a plane.
alt: A teal half of an angle bracket and its amber mirror image, meeting at the centre to complete the bracket and its round bore.

title: Linear pattern
blurb: Copies of a body stepped along a direction.
alt: A teal finned heat sink: nine fins stepped along a mounting plate.

title: Circular pattern
blurb: Copies spaced around an axis, used here to cut a ring of holes.
alt: A teal weld-neck flange with eight bolt holes in a circle round its neck.

title: Sketch constraints
blurb: Describe a profile by its relationships and sizes; the solver finds the shape.
alt: A teal angle bracket with a rounded bend and two holes in each leg, beside the rough amber outline the solver started from.

title: Offset
blurb: Grow or shrink an outline by a set distance to make walls and rims.
alt: An amber wall grown 3 mm round a teal L-shaped floor, with a groove shrunk inside the outline.

title: Text
blurb: Lettering becomes ordinary geometry you can raise, cut or engrave.
alt: A teal nameplate with CADPOLE in raised amber letters, PARAMETRIC CAD engraved beneath, and a countersunk hole at each end.

title: Emboss
blurb: Artwork wrapped around a curved face and raised from it.
alt: A teal pen cup with the number 42 raised on its curved side.

title: Smooth blend
blurb: Shapes described as distance fields merge with a soft radius.
alt: A teal lever knob: a round plate, a slender stem and a ball, joined by smooth fillets.

title: Twist
blurb: A field turned steadily about its axis, then turned into a mesh.
alt: A teal three-bladed column twisted most of a turn between a round foot and cap.

title: Section
blurb: Cut a part on a plane to see inside it.
alt: A teal V-belt pulley cut in half, the cut face in amber showing the hub, keyed bore, set-screw hole, web and grooved rim.

title: Drawing
blurb: Dimensioned three-view sheets, written out as PDF and DXF.
alt: A line drawing with top, front, right and pictorial views of a flanged boss, dimensioned in inches.
